verdict.rationale: Mastra is itself an official TypeScript framework that developers build against and add to React, Next.js and Node.js apps, and community users confirm building with it hands-on. However, the evidence never describes a dedicated official SDK, such as a client SDK for calling a Mastra server, SDKs in other languages, or an SDK API reference. No OpenAPI spec was found either. Missing for 10: explicitly documented official SDK(s) or client libraries, multi-language coverage, SDK reference documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Mastra is a framework for building AI-powered applications and agents with a modern TypeScript stack.
Mastra bundles agents and workflows directly into existing React, Next.js and Node.js apps, or ships them as standalone endpoints.
Add Mastra to an existing project, or create a new app with your preferred framework
